usedFor: Teable holds your table records, and Google Drive receives file copies through “Copy a File” and “Share File”.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Is Created” in Teable, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each new record gets its own file copy, placed in a selected folder.

watchOut: “Table Record Changes” in Teable is polling, so file actions run after a scheduled check.
